title: Message at the Front Desk  (前台的来信)

segments.t: 十分钟后，汉娜和亚瑟迈着轻快的步子穿过庭院大门回到凉爽的大厅。格雷厄姆正站在前台后面，手里拿一只黄色的加急信封轻轻敲着登记簿等着他们。请先完整听一遍这一幕。
You took your time — did the boss try his famous alley shortcut past the kitchen?
Never mind the route, Graham! What is that yellow envelope in your hand?!
Express station post, signed for at eleven-forty while you were chasing clock shadows.
Look at the sender line on the left — it is from our Room Eight mapmaker!
Open it, Hannah, open it before my glasses fall right off my nose!
Arriving in Portland next Saturday for the thirtieth May anniversary at Linden Courtyard!
Next Saturday?! The original guest from Room Eight is coming HERE in person?!
Read the last line at the bottom — that is the part for the kitchen.
Hoping with all my heart to taste one slice of that famous berry almond cake!
Merciful heavens, we still only have the TOP HALF of that cake recipe!
Better go ask Evelyn about that old green garden book in Room Four right now.
Up the stairs we go — next Saturday is seven days away, and the oven awaits!
现在我们逐句解析这第二集的大结局场景。
You took your time — did the boss try his famous alley shortcut past the kitchen?
'你们可真够慢的——老板是不是又试了他那条经过厨房门外小巷的著名近路？'
Never mind the route, Graham! What is that yellow envelope in your hand?!
'别管路线了，格雷厄姆！你手里拿着的那个黄色信封是什么？！'
Express station post, signed for at eleven-forty while you were chasing clock shadows.
'车站发来的加急邮件，十一点四十分签收的，那会儿你们正追着钟楼影子跑呢。'
Look at the sender line on the left — it is from our Room Eight mapmaker!
'快看左边发件人那一栏——是咱们八号房那位制图师寄来的！'
Open it, Hannah, open it before my glasses fall right off my nose!
'快拆开，汉娜，趁我眼镜还没直接从鼻梁上滑下来，赶紧拆开！'
Arriving in Portland next Saturday for the thirtieth May anniversary at Linden Courtyard!
'“下周六抵达波特兰，共赴菩提树庭院五月三十周年庆！”'
Next Saturday?! The original guest from Room Eight is coming HERE in person?!
'下周六？！八号房那位最初的房客要亲自来这里？！'
Read the last line at the bottom — that is the part for the kitchen.
'读读最底下最后一行——那才是跟咱们厨房有关的部分。'
Hoping with all my heart to taste one slice of that famous berry almond cake!
'“满怀期待地盼着品尝一块那著名的浆果杏仁蛋糕！”'
Merciful heavens, we still only have the TOP HALF of that cake recipe!
'老天爷，我们手里依然只有那份蛋糕食谱的上半截！'
Better go ask Evelyn about that old green garden book in Room Four right now.
'还是赶紧去四号房问问伊芙琳那本绿色园艺旧书的事吧。'
Up the stairs we go — next Saturday is seven days away, and the oven awaits!
'我们上楼去吧——离下周六还有七天，烤箱正等着咱们呢！'
让我们再完整听一遍这段对话。
You took your time — did the boss try his famous alley shortcut past the kitchen?
Never mind the route, Graham! What is that yellow envelope in your hand?!
Express station post, signed for at eleven-forty while you were chasing clock shadows.
Look at the sender line on the left — it is from our Room Eight mapmaker!
Open it, Hannah, open it before my glasses fall right off my nose!
Arriving in Portland next Saturday for the thirtieth May anniversary at Linden Courtyard!
Next Saturday?! The original guest from Room Eight is coming HERE in person?!
Read the last line at the bottom — that is the part for the kitchen.
Hoping with all my heart to taste one slice of that famous berry almond cake!
Merciful heavens, we still only have the TOP HALF of that cake recipe!
Better go ask Evelyn about that old green garden book in Room Four right now.
Up the stairs we go — next Saturday is seven days away, and the oven awaits!
那位退休的制图师下周六就要亲自来到波特兰，满心盼着品尝浆果杏仁蛋糕——而食谱的下半截至今还没有着落呢。第二集完，下次见。
See you next time!
